title: 1729 Prairie's big front dormer under its broken pediment
items: The large dormer on the Pullman house's Prairie front now carries the broken pediment its pictures show: two raking stone arms rise from past the hood's ears and stop against the arch, so the arch's crown stands up through the gap between them.
Read off the 1890 Albertype plate and Taylor's photograph no. 1445, with the Detroit print agreeing; the arms' rake, depth and reach are drawn at the precision those pictures allow.
